# Upstream workflows that run Omi's own infrastructure (Codemagic, Google Cloud,
# GKE, Grafana, PostHog, Vercel, Mintlify). They need Omi's accounts and secrets,
# which this fork does not have and must not have, so here they can only fail:
# 214 failed runs from 2026-10-18 to 10-25, each one a failure email.
# reece-disable-upstream-ops.yml keeps every workflow listed here disabled.
# One file name per line. Delete a line, then enable the workflow in Actions,
# to bring it back.

# Mobile builds and rollout (Codemagic)
mobile_internal_build.yml
mobile_rollout_watch.yml

# Desktop release monitoring (PostHog)
desktop_release_doctor.yml

# Deploys to Omi's Google Cloud / GKE
desktop_backend_auto_dev.yml
gcp_admin.yml
gcp_app.yml
gcp_backend_auto_dev.yml
gcp_backend_listen_helm.yml
gcp_backend_pusher_auto_deploy.yml
gcp_cloud_run_metrics_egress.yml
gcp_firestore_indexes.yml
gcp_frontend.yml
gcp_memory_maintenance_job_auto_dev.yml
gcp_storage_lifecycle.yml
firestore_read_reconcile.yml

# Omi's dashboards, docs and prototypes
grafana_dashboard_provisioning.yml
sync-docs.yml
reid_onboarding_vercel.yml
